'''Skann''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG9" /> located in the [[Skann system/Legends|Skann system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Astal sector/Legends|Astal sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was inhabited by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] who grew [[Plant/Legends|crops]] such as [[Dust-Corn]] and [[Dry Gene Wheat]]. The farmers made the unique [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] [[Skannbult Likker]], which was possibly the most volatile [[Alcohol/Legends|fire-water]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], from surplus crops, distilling it in rock basins.<ref name="GG9" />

The quality of the Likker on Skann varied greatly, with the smaller farmers far from major [[City/Legends|towns]] creating the best variety of the beverage. At the [[Skann spacers' bar]], on the other hand, [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] frequently could obtain only quick-brewed [[Rotgut/Legends|rotgut]]. [[Kina Margath]], the owner of the [[Margath's on Elshandruu Pica|Margath's]] entertainment complex on the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]] world [[Elshandruu Pica]], managed to obtain a small supply of high-quality Skannbult Likker<ref name="GG9" /> at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Skann was mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Skann [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Skann, in grid square Q-18.<ref name="TEA" />
